title: The pup at eight, the scale
logline: The vet's scale with the pup on it, three legs on the platform, the needle where it always is, the vet's hand on his back — the one hand-on-the-dog that isn't Wood's. The page draws the needle without its number.

panels.composition: A veterinary floor scale with a small three-legged dog standing on it, a vet's hand in a green sleeve resting on its back, the dial's needle visible but its numbers not.
